messages:
alex: Originate RC service@2.4.7-rc1
artifact: sha:abc1234
Requesting hotpath escrow + canary signoff. Change window 2026-03-22 22:00-22:15 UTC. Need one +1 from QA and one from oncall.

mira: QA canary eval started. running smoke set 'chatflow-short'

deploy-bot: [info] creating RC tag: service-2.4.7-rc1
[info] pushing to staging cluster svc-staging
[cmd] ./deploy --artifact=sha:abc1234 --env=staging

mira: canary metrics after 5m: p95 85ms p99 118ms errors 0.03% -> ok :thumbsup:

jamal: release notes draft: "fix token leak in cache, improved kv-warm" link: https://go/release-notes/2.4.7-rc1

sylvie: ops: will pin routing to rc in k8s: 
```
kubectl set image deploy/service service=service:2.4.7-rc1 -n prod
kubectl annotate deploy/service rollout=hotpath-escrow
```

ops-oncall: I'm on watch 22:00-22:45 UTC. Abort criteria: p50>200ms or 5xx>0.5% for 2 consecutive mins. I'll post abort if hit.

luis: +1 from infra for reserved capacity and autoscaler tweak.

alex: ok schedule promote at 22:00 UTC. deploy-bot, schedule promo with 10% initial traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 12m, fallback to service:2.4.6 if abort.

deploy-bot: scheduled promotion at 2026-03-22T22:00:00Z
plan:
 - 22:00 -> 10%
 - 22:04 -> 50%
 - 22:12 -> 100%
fallback: immediate rollback to service:2.4.6

mira: after canary confirm, add eval tests: rerank-smoke, context-truncation.

jamal: rollback command if abort:
```
./deploy --rollback-to=service:2.4.6 --reason=\"rc-2.4.7-rc1 abort\"
deploy-bot rollback <run-id>
```

sylvie: noted, will hold DB-migration flag false. no migrations in rc.

ops-oncall: copy that. i'll start a thread in incidents if we hit abort.

alex: final signoffs: mira, ops-oncall, luis, sylvie ?

mira: +1

ops-oncall: +1

luis: +1

sylvie: +1

alex: thanks. deploying. ping here with deploy-bot updates. :rocket:
